method: Evaluated rest/posed endpoints in the same world coordinate system. Every integer action frame, unchanged FPS. Edge indices and vertex skin influences retained.
limitations: Numeric stretch warnings require visual judgement; no automatic deformation pass.
Integrated garments may lack a separate inner body; no fictional zero-penetration metric is emitted.
Short/zero-length rest edges are separately reported, not silently omitted.
Source clip provenance and retarget correctness must be validated by the owning task.

weights.exception_reason: Bounded axilla five-influence test to avoid discontinuous top-four palette truncation. Requires Unity Custom import and Unlimited skinning; not a universal default change.
